answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, ensuring that validator influence scales linearly with capital at stake rather than identity count. Like a raven circling the desolate tundra, an attacker seeking to dominate must accumulate massive wealth, turning their initial investment into a cooling ember if they attempt to double-spend. This economic friction mandates that every additional agent identity incurs significant, verifiable monetary cost, effectively pricing out malicious actors.
